summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds an enum import and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with eleven commented members. botocore/args.py imports the enum as EPRBuiltins, adds a None branch to _should_set_global_sts_endpoint, and adds compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. The 59 tests in test_args.py pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py and test_session*.py that also fail with my changes stashed, so they predate this work. black and flake8 are not installed in the venv, so line length was checked by hand. Nothing is committed. Open decision: the helper calls the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint as the spec requires; making them public is a possible follow-up.
